laws.rule: Qinghai Lake Scenic Area Protection and Utilisation Administration: drones may not be flown over wildlife and bird habitats. Named no-fly areas are Bird Island, Sand Island, Haixin Mountain, Sankuaishi, Quanwan-Gariala, Heimahe wetland, Daotanghe wetland, Er'hai, Ganzihe wetland, Xiannvwan wetland, and the Ganzihe-Hargai Przewalski's gazelle range. A January 2025 notice repeats that drones must not be used to disturb or chase wildlife.

Qinghai Lake: people and motor vehicles are banned from the lake ice. Entering the core zone of the Qinghai Lake National Nature Reserve is banned for any unit, group or person; Haixin Mountain and Sankuaishi are core zones, and tours built on crossing to them are banned. Photographers and visitors may not enter the Quanwan wetland area (swan wintering ground). Off-road vehicle events on the Gahai and Jinshawan sand areas are banned.

layers.process: Winter notices ban people and vehicles on the lake ice, and ban entry to the nature reserve core zone (Haixin Mountain, Sankuaishi) and the Quanwan wetland. These are closures, not permits; no published way to apply was found.
